description:
Look up a provider in the CMS NPPES National Provider Identifier registry. Accepts a 10-digit NPI number OR a provider name (optionally narrowed by 2-char state). Returns up to 20 matches with entity type, specialty, taxonomy code, address, and status. Source: CMS NPPES public API (free, no key required).

WHEN TO USE: User wants to verify a specific provider by NPI number, or find a provider by name + state.

WHEN NOT: For provider performance analytics (provider_efficiency_score).

EXAMPLES:
- Look up a provider by NPI number: `{"npi_number":"1234567893"}`

state.description: Optional 2-char state abbreviation to narrow a name search.

name: lookup_npi
